model_annotation: Figure 3 presents a pie chart illustrating the degree of agreement with the statement "Design is well integrated into the product development process in our organization." The chart consists of five sectors, each representing a different level of integration: "Изцяло е интегриран" (completely integrated) in blue, "Много добре е интегриран" (very well integrated) in orange, "Добре е интегриран" (well integrated) in green, "Слабо е интегриран" (weakly integrated) in red, and "Не е интегриран така подход" (not integrated at all) in purple. The percentages for each sector are approximately 10%, 24%, 25%, 8%, and 20%, respectively. The chart does not include a legend, but the color-coded sectors are listed in a key next to the chart. No sectors are visually highlighted or emphasized through size or color variation. The sectors appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest sectors in the middle of the chart.
